claims.text: The harbor closure began before the public safety bulletin was issued.
All outbound freight was stopped during the closure.

evidence.title: Port authority gate log, shift C
evidence.excerpt: Gate 4 changed to outbound hold at 22:18. Public bulletin timestamp in the archive is 22:41.

evidence.title: Interview transcript with night operations supervisor, corrected second edition with appended clarification
evidence.author: Mina Serrano
evidence.excerpt: The supervisor recalls the public advisory as preceding the full outbound hold, but could not identify the exact gate state.

evidence.title: Dispatch radio archive
evidence.excerpt: Audio segment is partially inaudible from 22:29 to 22:37.
